combo_label: Around the House × At the Funfair × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Tenth of the harvest owed to the parish, stored in a barn built for it
Swinging counterweight engine that lobbed boulders over the tallest defences
Bottle-shaped pit reached only by a trapdoor, where a prisoner was left to rot
Down-filled bag in a washable cover, which retired the blanket and top sheet
Loud-voiced tout drumming up a crowd for the next attraction
Outwork before the gate that funnelled attackers into a killing ground
Drum ride that pins you to the wall as the floor drops away
Log ride that ends with a splash down a watery chute
Shelved stack against the wall, sagging under paperbacks never reread
Stone floor the fire sits on, once the centre of the household
Gas behind the glowing signs above every ride
